name: Phantasm Spiral Power
effectText: If all monsters you control are Normal Monsters (min. 1): Target 1 Effect Monster your opponent controls; until the end of this turn, it loses 1000 ATK and DEF, also it has its effects negated. You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 Normal Monster you control; equip 1 "Phantasm Spiral" Equip Spell from your hand or GY to that Normal Monster.
